definitions.explanation: The residents or citizens of a town (町). Used in official and administrative contexts to refer to the people living in a municipality classified as a 町.

examples.japanese: {町民|ちょうみん}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: A notice was delivered to all town residents.

examples.japanese: {町民|ちょうみん}⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}される→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: An event will be held at the town gymnasium.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{条例|じょうれい}→条例：08255_jourei⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{町民|ちょうみん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They are soliciting opinions from town residents regarding the new ordinance.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in administrative and official contexts. Japan's municipalities are classified as ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧ (city), {町|ちょう}/⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧ (town), or ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧/{村|そん} (village), and each has its own term for residents: ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧, {町民|ちょうみん}, ⟦{村民|そんみん}→村民：22347_sonmin⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {町民|ちょうみん}{税|ぜい} (town resident tax)
- {町民|ちょうみん}⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧ (town gymnasium)
- {町民|ちょうみん}⟦{会館|かいかん}→会館：04119_kaikan⟧ (town community hall)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧: city residents — for cities (⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧)
- ⟦{村民|そんみん}→村民：22347_sonmin⟧: village residents — for villages (⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧)
- ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧: residents — a general term for residents of any area
